text:
Which statement explains why increasing the concentration of a reactant increases the rate of the
reaction?
A
A greater proportion of the particles have the activation energy so there are more successful
collisions.
B
Particles have more energy so there are more frequent collisions.
C
There are more particles in the same volume so there are more frequent collisions.
D
The particles move more quickly so there are more frequent collisions.
